prose.ld_note: Three flyer posts are live (18, 17 and 10 Nov) and all six flyer images print prices valid until Sat 28 Nov, so these hold for a Tuesday or Wednesday shop: the Thanksgiving flyer (17 and 24 Nov) with top sirloin steaks $16.99/lb, top sirloin roasts $15.99/lb, frozen lamb legs $7.29/lb, fresh red snapper fillets $17.99/lb, salmon $24.99/lb, Cornish hens $7.20, Campbell's cream of mushroom soup $1.99, Land O Lakes butter $8.45 a pound and Tree Ripe orange juice 52 oz $7.65; the Great Brands Autumn Savings flyer (17 Nov) with Spice Islands spices, coffee, cereal, drinks, cleaning and pet lines; the Kraft Heinz Shop for the Feast and Great Deals on Great Brands flyers (10 Nov, Tyson thighs 5 lb $18.45, Anchor butter $7.59, Pillsbury dough, Betty Crocker mixes, Scott 4 roll $5.85); and the two Lindo's Next Level bulk flyers (18 and 10 Nov). 234 lines in all. The flyers were machine read on the laptop on 20 Nov and checked by hand the same day: the OCR pass returned 170 lines but flagged 108 as doubtful and mangled most product names and sections, so the whole set was re-transcribed from the images; where the two could be compared the OCR had Dan-O's seasoning at $15.27 (flyer $15.75) and Tide EVO at $3.45 (flyer $34.45). Deli cheese and chicken breast lines marked Devonshire only are at Lindo's Market, not Family Foods. 5% off on Tuesdays and Wednesdays through 2026 (excludes alcohol, pharmacy, general merchandise, seasonal).
prose.sm_note: The flyer for Wed 18 to Sun 22 Nov (35 lines) is the one in the table: sirloin steak $15.99/lb, stir fry beef strips $15.49/lb, sirloin roast $16.49/lb, English ham $18.99/lb, Faroe Island salmon $24.99/lb, green cabbage $1.49/lb, broccoli $3.69/lb, Gala apples $8.29 a 3 lb bag, Tree Ripe orange juice 59 oz $6.99, Jif 16 oz $4.99, Barritts 4 packs $5.49, Jacob's cream crackers $4.79 and Waitrose cat food 12 pouches $11.99. It ends Sunday, so for a Tuesday or Wednesday shop look for the Wed 25 to Sun 29 Nov flyer, which Supermart normally posts on the Monday; the collector will pick it up and the OCR will read it on Tuesday morning. This flyer was transcribed by hand on 17 Nov and re-checked on 20 Nov against the laptop's machine read of the same image (33 lines): every price agreed except Jacob's crackers and Barritts tonic water, where the OCR was wrong. Thanksgiving turkey pre-orders from $7.49/lb are still open (pick up 24 to 26 Nov). Waitrose range is exclusive to Supermart; next $250 reward card draw Mon 23 Nov.
prose.staples_overall: Overall: MarketPlace is cheapest on 18 of the 26 staple rows, with eggs at $2.89 a dozen, store family pack thighs $3.25/lb, Tyson breast $4.99/lb, family pack ground beef now $5.49/lb (down from $5.79 on 16 Nov, the only move on its shelf), Kerrygold $4.79, Tide 25 oz $7.79 and Charmin 4 mega rolls $9.99. Pronto wins six rows (Kraft cheddar block $5.49, Pepperidge Farm bread $8.29, Cheerios $8.89, Dawn $4.49, the only Tropicana 46 oz at $8.59 and a Corn Flakes 12 oz listing at $5.92 that looks like a unit price, so check the tag) and Miles two (Jif $4.95 and Dave's Killer Powerseed $8.75); Miles' site returned only 16 of its rows on 20 Nov, so several of its cells are blank rather than beaten. Pronto's Charmin 6 mega rolls edged up from $13.09 to $13.19. Supermart's flyer still undercuts on orange juice (Tree Ripe 59 oz $6.99 beats every Tropicana carton per ounce) but it ends Sunday; Lindo's Chobani cups at $2.29 (to 28 Nov) beat MarketPlace's $2.84 shelf price.

prose.rshops_sub: Newest post from each shop in the weekly sweep, grouped by category. Each shop's line ends with its tier: weekly (web store or a post in the last 30 days), monthly (checked on the first run of each month, including shops not yet found) or parked (no post in over a year, checked in January, April, July and October). This was a weekly sweep on Fri 20 Nov: 26 retail Facebook pages were read in the browser pane (signed in, so dates are exact) and the collector re-read the Red Laser, Gosling's, Masters, Phoenix, P-Tech and Annex Toys sites the same morning, where the only new upload was Masters' Christmas giveaway poster. Five weekly shops whose page address was never recorded could not be re-read (Gorham's, Baptiste, Rowe Spurling Paint, Sportseller and Bermuda Bookstore) and carry their earlier note; Burrows Lightbourn sits behind its 18+ wall. New offers: Crisson's Black Friday week (up to 40% off Pandora), Waterfront Man's 25% off with a Butterfield Mastercard, and Masters' $75,000 Christmas draw with 10% Thursdays and 15% senior Wednesdays now printed on the poster. Four pages have had no post for over three weeks (Audio Visual Electronics 1 Nov, Urban Cottage 4 Nov, Flying Colours 4 Nov, Alexandra Mosher 26 Oct) and move to the monthly tier if nothing appears by the 1 Dec run; Sunglass and Watch Shop's newest post is from 17 Sep and goes monthly now. The monthly-tier shops and the 20 shops not yet found are next checked on the first run of December; parked shops in January.
prose.eats_sub: Quick food across the island: fast food, chicken and jerk, pizza, sushi, Indian, Chinese and local takeout, with hours, phone, delivery and menu links. Deals and notices at the top come from each place's newest public Facebook post, website specials page and Sargasso Sea listing, read on 20 Nov (12 Facebook pages, 2 websites and the collector's Sargasso Sea store list from the same morning; Pizza House's page again showed "content isn't available" even signed in). New this week: La Trattoria's Thanksgiving buffet on Thu 26 Nov and its Thanksgiving takeout menu, and L'Oriental's last two Japan buffet nights (23 and 24 Nov). The collector's 7:41am Sargasso read showed 59 of 183 storefronts closed, which is just the hour, so it says nothing about who has shut; Spot's own page was posting on 13 Nov. Hours are from listings and can drift, so a call before a long ride is worth it.
